prose: The Information profiles Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's EVP of Copilot and a potential Satya Nadella successor, tracing the effort to fix Copilot after summer 2025 customer complaints about bugginess; a source says Microsoft is on track to pay Anthropic $2B+ per year. Basis: the article is paywalled and only the standfirst was retrievable.
highlights: Profile: Charles Lamanna, Copilot EVP and potential Nadella successor.
A source says Microsoft is on track to pay Anthropic $2B+ per year.
Context: Copilot quality complaints in summer 2025 kicked off the repair effort.
